# AutoHotkey v2.0.26 for Linux — linux.20

Closes the check_detail0901 P0 safety/semantics backlog and its follow-on
milestones: inputd replay fail-open (P0-1), the official SendLevel/InputLevel
and SendMode Input semantics (P0-2/P1-3), protocol v2 identity/provenance with
broker-owned injection and multi-client arbitration (P0-3/M3/M4), unified
backend health (M2a), the normalized input pipeline through dynamic HotIf
deadlines (M5a/M5b), consented libei injection (M6a), unified D-Bus/Wayland
recovery (M7), rich multi-MIME ClipboardAll with concurrent-user-copy
protection (P2-6), and Unicode/IME hardening (P2-10, P2-11).

## Highlights

- **P0-1 inputd replay fail-open.** The replay device is created and fully
  validated before any grab; runtime write failures release all grabs,
  broadcast `BACKEND_DEGRADED` and set systemd `STATUS=degraded`; two-phase
  `EVIOCGKEY` grabbing removes stuck keys (12/12 fault oracle).
- **P0-2/P1-3 Send semantics.** One policy entry enforces the official strict
  `send_level > input_level` rule, InputHook MinSendLevel semantics and
  `SendMode "Input"` hook-unloaded behavior (22/22 Windows-golden oracle).
- **P0-3/M3 protocol v2.** `AHK2` framed socket with HELLO negotiation,
  script nonces, authoritative provenance envelopes and v1 fallback; broker-
  owned INJECT transactions with TTL/quotas/crash balancing; static
  multi-client OBSERVE/SUPPRESS/EXCLUSIVE/REMAP arbitration (oracles 25/25,
  24/24, 29/29).
- **M2a health, M5 pipeline, M6a libei, M7 recovery.** Typed
  health/generation state with restart reconciliation; a normalized
  reducer→matcher→decision pipeline with rollback gate and dynamic HotIf
  deadlines; a consented RemoteDesktop/libei injection route; bounded D-Bus
  pending calls and full Wayland generation-tracked rebuild on compositor
  restart (each fault class gated by its own oracle).
- **P2-6 rich ClipboardAll.** Multi-MIME snapshots (text/HTML/PNG/URI-list/
  custom) with checksums and bounds; the paste-fallback restore is a
  compare-and-swap on selection ownership — a concurrent user copy wins.
  X11↔Wayland clipboard bridging is documented as a compositor environment
  capability (wlroots #295).
- **P2-10/P2-11 Unicode/IME.** Strict UTF-8 validation, invalid-commit
  drop-before-state, mutex-protected IME state, off-thread framework probe;
  the full §22 grapheme/ZWJ corpus is gated over real Fcitx5 D-Bus signals;
  the combo oracle gains shared-prefix/modifier/repeat rows.
- **Stability.** One borrow lease per literal run (bounded 5 s) removes
  cross-process SendText starvation; Debug/ASan link fixed (mismatched
  `inline` member definitions); IME engine snapshots mutex-copied.

## Verification

- Doc-check **1170/1170** on the normal and ASan builds (five new
  paste-restore-CAS assertions), headless regression **27/27**, Wayland
  **17/17**, XWayland **234/234**.
- All P0-1/P0-2/P0-3/M2/M4/M5/M6/M7 oracles, the Windows v2.0.26
  differential trace gate, the four-distro container matrix, TSan input
  gate, pack-container acceptance and the package lifecycle job are green
  in CI.
- Linux VM stress evidence for the new code: 30/30 unicode-lease runs,
  15/15 under CPU load, 5/5 under ASan; paste-restore unit oracle PASS with
  the takeover case; ClipboardAll multi-MIME round-trip 20/20.

## Important limits

- This remains a technology preview, not a claim of complete Win32 parity.
- The deb/RPM inputd service stays opt-in (`systemctl enable --now
  ahk-inputd.socket`) and requires trusted users in group `input` with a
  logout/login.
- Pure Wayland broker character streams still need a compositor layout
  source; real Fcitx5 desktop visibility, KDE and Flatpak host matrices and
  InputCapture retain their explicitly documented environment/upstream
  limits.  X11↔Wayland clipboard bridging requires a compositor-side sync
  agent (wlroots #295).
- The 24-hour soak remains cancelled by request; CI 30-second and VM
  5-minute evidence stand and no 24-hour claim is made.

## Checksums

```bash
sed -n 's/^  //p' CKSUMS.txt > checksums.sha256
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256

gh attestation verify <downloaded-file> \
  --repo MonoEven/Autohotkey_Linux
```

The Sigstore/GitHub attestation binds each digest to this repository, tag
workflow and commit. See `SECURITY.md`, `docs-v2/docs/howto/Install.htm` and
`docs-v2/docs/linux-port.htm` for details.
